parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main structural body of the keyboard, typically made of aluminum for durability and rigidity.
parts.Functional_description: It provides support and housing for all keys and internal components, maintaining the keyboard’s shape and protecting internal circuits.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Key
parts.Basic_description: A keycap made of ABS plastic, forming the interactive surface of the keyboard.
parts.Functional_description: Each key transmits user input to the keyboard’s internal circuit when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: Each key moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring or membrane mechanism.
